# The ONE Dify plugin pin table (#2545). Read by `rzfz post-install`
# (dify_install_plugin, via razzfazz_dify_plugin_pin) and by an offline package (Enterprise)
# (the package carries exactly these members). Columns, TAB-separated:
#   plugin    pinned version    full identifier (name:version@checksum)    required|optional
# required: every box installs it, so a package build fails without it. optional:
# installed only on some boxes (gpustack: only with a GPUStack profile, #1248), so a
# build box without it warns and the package carries none. A 3-column row (older
# tags) is required.
# gpustack: >=0.0.15 for chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking passthrough (0.0.8
# silently drops it); 0.0.16 (#1968).
# openai_api_compatible: 0.0.34 -> 0.0.66 (#1968). It carries EVERY model
# registration of this stack. Compatibility was checked field by field against
# provider/openai_api_compatible.yaml: 0.0.66 requires endpoint_url (always),
# context_size (llm/text-embedding/rerank) and max_chunks (text-embedding, #1509);
# _dify_register_models sends all three, and each of the 16 new fields is optional.
# Note: max_chunks is absent from the 0.0.34 schema, so #1509 was measured on a CPU test box
# against a NEWER plugin than the old pin.
# openai_api_compatible: 0.0.66 -> 0.0.83 (#3233). 0.0.66 has the structured-output
# capability COMMENTED OUT in models/llm/llm.py (`entity.features.append(
# ModelFeature.STRUCTURED_OUTPUT)`), so Dify 1.18 refuses every structured-output node
# at stage=capability; 0.0.83 appends it when the credential says
# structured_output_support supported|native (read in the package, llm.py:272-275).
# Boxes only worked because Dify's fix_only auto-upgrade had moved the daemon to 0.0.83.
# Credential schema vs 0.0.66: nothing removed, nothing newly required; new optional
# multimodal_embedding_format; stream_function_calling gains `native`. Every field
# _dify_register_models / _dify_manager_llm_extras sends exists with our values.
# 0.0.83 ran on 0.91 (plugin daemon 0.6.12) 11-11..11-13. Apache-2.0 (dify-official-plugins).
# an offline package (Enterprise) refuses a build whose openai_api_compatible does not advertise it.
